result.instructions: Tools for HolidayPitches, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which pitches are free for 14 to 18 August, and which take dogs?"; "Show me today's arrivals and departures from the bookings list."; "Check in booking HP-101 and tell me its total cost.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes HolidayPitches data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run holidaypitches_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run holidaypitches_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run holidaypitches_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. holidaypitches_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: holidaypitches_get_campsite
tools.title: Get campsite details
tools.description: Get the campsite's name, address, contact details, season dates, business types and vocabulary labels. HolidayPitches API: GET /api/ext/v1/campsite (scope read_campsite).

tools.name: holidaypitches_list_pitches
tools.title: List pitches
tools.description: List the campsite's pitches and units with unit type, services, dog policy, length limit and price per night. Set active to true for bookable units only. HolidayPitches API: GET /api/ext/v1/pitches (scope read_pitches).

tools.name: holidaypitches_check_availability
tools.title: Check pitch availability
tools.description: List every active pitch for an arrival and departure window, with an is_available flag per pitch. HolidayPitches API: GET /api/ext/v1/availability (scope read_availability).

tools.name: holidaypitches_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings with guest, pitch, dates, party size, status and cost. Filter by status or arrival window. Use offset to page; count gives the total. HolidayPitches API: GET /api/ext/v1/bookings (scope read_bookings).

arrival_from.description: Only bookings arriving on or after this date.

arrival_to.description: Only bookings arriving on or before this date.

tools.name: holidaypitches_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Get one booking by its reference (e.g. HP-101) or numeric id, with guest, pitch, dates, party size, status and total cost. HolidayPitches API: GET /api/ext/v1/bookings/{ref} (scope read_bookings).

ref.description: Booking reference (e.g. HP-101) or numeric booking id.

tools.name: holidaypitches_create_booking
tools.title: Create a booking
tools.description: Create a confirmed booking for one pitch and date range. Reuses the guest account with the same email or creates one. Fails with a conflict when the pitch is taken. Adds a booking; it does not change existing ones. HolidayPitches API: POST /api/ext/v1/bookings/create (scope write_bookings).

tools.name: holidaypitches_update_booking_status
tools.title: Update a booking status
tools.description: Move a booking to a new status. Allowed moves: pending → confirmed or cancelled; confirmed → checked_in or cancelled; checked_in → checked_out. Read the booking first with holidaypitches_get_booking. HolidayPitches API: PATCH /api/ext/v1/bookings/{ref}/status (scope write_bookings).

ref.description: Booking reference (e.g. HP-101) or numeric booking id.

status.description: New status: confirmed, checked_in, checked_out or cancelled.
